# Dora

## Overview

- **Age:** 11-12 years old  <sub>[v1 c18 P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), [v2 c1 P31](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0031), [v2 c10 P12](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0012), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v3 c1 P31](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0031), [v3 c39 P5](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0005)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive; adopted orphan  <sub>[v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022)</sub>
- **Origin:** East Grafton, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** School student  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Dora is a fair, neat, and proper girl. She has long, sleek, hazelnut-colored curls that never get out of order, gentle and mild hazel eyes, a straight nose, and a prim mouth. She is the twin sister of Davy Keith, but looks nothing like him.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P26](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0026)_

## Personality

Dora is exceedingly well-behaved, quiet, orderly, and methodical. She is obedient, careful, and faithful in performing her chores without needing to be reminded. Though her calm and subdued nature causes some to view her as a bit dull or monotonous, she is gentle, polite, and easily frightened by spooky stories or cows.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P30](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0030), [v2 c1 P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006), [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P28](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0028), [v2 c10 P89](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0089), [v2 c10 P90](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0090), [v2 c13 P29](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0029), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c21 P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 c26 P33](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0033), [v3 c1 P8](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0008)_

## History

Dora Keith and her twin brother Davy were orphaned in East Grafton when they were six years old. Their third cousin, Marilla Cuthbert, agreed to take them in at Green Gables upon their mother's death. Unlike her turbulent twin brother, Dora settled into life at Green Gables very smoothly, always behaving with utmost propriety, cleanliness, and obedience. She began attending school in Avonlea, sharing a desk with Lily Sloane and later Mirabel Cotton. After her uncle Richard Keith passed away, leaving a trust fund for her and Davy, her permanent home at Green Gables was secured. As she grew older, she inherited Anne Shirley's old porch gable room at Green Gables. By the time she was seventeen, she began receiving romantic attentions from Ralph Andrews.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c1 P31](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0031), [v2 c7 P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000), [v2 c8 P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v3 c39 P3](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0003), [v3 c39 P5](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0005), [v4 c4 P2](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0002)_

- Lost her father when she was a baby and her mother when she was six  <sub>[v2 c1 P31](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0031), [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033)</sub>
